notes: Checked against Servier Medical Art's Terms of use and its pages on what users may do and how to credit. The images are CC BY 4.0, and Servier's own FAQ says they may be used in a paid course or subscription platform and in a mobile app, so a paid app may show one with the credit in attribution. Conditions: the app mustn't be marketed as an image library or collection, mustn't suggest Servier (a pharmaceutical company, Les Laboratoires Servier) endorses Ceder, and mustn't use Servier's names or logos. Only the images are CC BY: the site's own text, layout and databases aren't. The terms forbid bots and scrapers on the site's content, so images are downloaded by hand, not by a tool. The site presents the images as illustrations; none was checked for photographs of people, which would need consent. The library's pin command doesn't fetch from Servier, so a library item for one of its images is written by hand. The bank's agents don't read it and nothing from it goes into the bank.
